name: unwordy
description: Makes coding agents write like a terse developer in code comments, commits, PRs, tracker comments and replies. Hooks block AI attribution and filler before it reaches the repo.

interface.shortDescription: Write like a terse developer, not an assistant
interface.longDescription: Loads a short style profile at session start, adds skills for commit messages, PR bodies and tracker comments, and blocks AI attribution trailers and restating comments with deterministic hooks.
defaultPrompt: Write the commit message for these changes
Rewrite this PR description so a human would write it
